title: Meeting Albert Ammons and Meade Lux Lewis in the studio
summary: Turner met the two pianists at Hammond's recording session, and Ammons bought a pint of scotch.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: That's where they was workin' at. Cafe Society, an' we didn't know them then, but we met 'em in the studio. John Hammond was recordin' all of us. And so we got together, laughin' and talkin'. Albert Ammons said, 'Let's get a little drink.' Said, 'Okay.'

So Albert Ammons went out and bought a pint of Johnny Walker Red Scotch. That's how come us to meet. They was workin' at...they was already...John Hammond...I mean, John Hammond was a...knowed Barney Josephson. In fact, he loaned him some money to open up his nightclub.
